'Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes' Reveals Lead Cast, Main Staff, First Promo for Winter 2027

Additional Cast Pair for 'Junket Bank' Announced
The official website of the television anime adaptation of Ikkou Tanaka's Junket Bank manga announced an additional pair of cast on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo affiliates at 12:00 a.m. every Tuesday beginning in October 2026. Voice actors Wataru Hatano (Fate/strange Fake) and Daisuke Hirakawa (Yuusha no Kuzu) are joining the cast as Keiichi Shishigami and Reiji Murasame, respectively.
